doNotInfer: Do NOT treat this PR's content as a finished, legally-reviewed privacy policy or terms of service. Issue #1971 is explicit: 'Content is owner-led — this issue tracks the requirement and the pages, not the wording.' Every legal-specific fact (entity details, retention period, jurisdiction, liability, warranty, termination, dispute resolution) is an explicit [OWNER: ...] placeholder (OwnerPlaceholder component), not drafted legal language.

Do NOT submit the Google OAuth consent screen to Google from this change. That console action, and confirming the verification requirements for the scopes in use, is the owner's per the issue and is explicitly out of scope here.

Do NOT add the Google sign-in button or touch apps/demo. The actual 'Đăng nhập với Google' control lives in apps/demo/src/components/demo-landing.tsx; the issue's hazards say not to touch apps/demo. The landing's own sign-in surface (the hero's 'Đăng nhập / Đăng ký' CTA into LOGIN_URL) is what carries the new consent-note links instead.

Do NOT infer that the data-handling sections describe a fully-shipped production-write feature. Section 4 of /privacy states production writes are default-off, sandbox-only today except a single-use, owner-authorized, per-listing path (ADR-085) — do not strengthen or weaken that claim without re-checking the code.

Do NOT key every paragraph of the legal body copy into dictionary.md. This app's existing convention (verified against apps/landing/src/components/*, dictionary.md) keys short reusable UI strings (nav/CTA labels, headings) but not long-form prose (hero body paragraphs, feature descriptions) — the legal pages follow the same split.
